title: Pan-Seared Gambas with Garlic Butter Sauce
description: A simple yet flavorful Spanish dish featuring succulent shrimp, garlic butter, and a hint of Asian inspiration. Serve with crusty bread or over rice for a quick and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: spanish
ingredients.notes: optional, can substitute with chicken broth

instructions: 1. Rinse the shrimp under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
2. In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium-high heat.
3. Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
4. Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
5. Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
6. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter and the white wine (if using).
7. Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet and bring the mixture to a simmer.
8. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
9. Stir in the chopped parsley and Korean chili flakes (if using).
10. Return the shrimp to the skillet and toss to coat with the garlic butter sauce.
11. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
12. Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
